insight: Both John 10:10 and Luke 19:10 emphasize Jesus' purposeful coming from heaven, with John highlighting that He came to give abundant, eternal life, contrasting the destructive intent of the thief, while Luke focuses on Jesus' mission to seek and save those who are spiritually lost. The verbs "I am come" in John and "is come" in Luke affirm the incarnation as a definitive act with divine intent. Together, these verses reveal complementary aspects of Christ's mission: He actively pursues the lost and rescues them, granting them not only salvation but a superabundant, ongoing life rooted in God's eternal nature.
